method: Synthetic MouseState events queued from a PlayMode coroutine through InputSystem, XRUIInputModule and the production GraphicRaycaster; no direct onClick calls
isolation: Temporary synthetic Mouse device; XRUIInputModule temporarily set to InputSystemActions to avoid legacy input overwriting injected state. Original mode restored and device removed after verification.
limitations: OS-generated mouse injection was not reliably delivered to the Game view; physical mouse input under the retained Both setting is not certified by this test.
Physical PICO controller ray input requires headset verification.
